## Review checklist

- [ ] The draft was reviewed and publication was explicitly approved.
- [ ] HTB content covers a retired/public machine and authorized use only.
- [ ] Flags, credentials, tokens, private addresses, and personal data are redacted.
- [ ] Title and 120–160 character description accurately describe the article.
- [ ] Categories and tags use consistent spelling.
- [ ] The 1200 × 630 social image exists and has useful alt text.
- [ ] Commands and technical claims were verified.
- [ ] Internal links and image paths work.
- [ ] Draft build and HTML-Proofer checks pass.
